result.topic_en: Euler writes out the expansions of a product-type expression of the sums ∫1/z^m and ∫1/z^n (and mixed terms with y), separated into parts according to whether m and n are odd or even.
result.transcription:
150 MEDITATIONES CIRCA
ſiue hoc modo
$2\int\frac{1}{z^m}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^n}+\frac{2m(m+1)}{1.\ 2}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+2}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{n-2}}$
$+\frac{2m(m+1)(m+2)(m+3)}{1.\ 2.\ 3.\ 4}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+4}}\int\frac{1}{z^{n-4}}+\text{etc.}$
$-\int\frac{1}{z^m}\left(\frac{1}{y^n}\right)-\frac{m}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+1}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{n-1}}\right)-\frac{m(m+1)}{1.\ 2.}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+2}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{n-2}}\right)\text{ etc.}$
Pars prima ſi m ſit numerus impar:
$-\frac{2m}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+1}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{n-1}}-\frac{2m(m+1)(m+2)}{1.\ 2.\ 3}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+3}}\int\frac{1}{z^{n-3}}-\text{etc.}$
$+\int\frac{1}{z^m}\left(\frac{1}{y^n}\right)+\frac{m}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+1}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{n-1}}\right)+\frac{m(m+1)}{1.\ 2.}\int\frac{1}{z^{m+2}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{n-2}}\right)\text{ etc.}$
Pro poſterior ſi n ſit numerus par.
$2\int\frac{1}{z^n}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^m}+\frac{2n(n+1)}{1.\ 2}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+2}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{m-2}}$
$+\frac{2n(n+1)(n+2)(n+3)}{1.\ 2.\ 3.\ 4}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+4}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{m-4}}\text{ etc.}$
$-\int\frac{1}{z^n}\left(\frac{1}{y^m}\right)-\frac{n}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+1}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{m-1}}\right)-\frac{n(n+1)}{1.\ 2}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+2}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{m-2}}\right)-\text{etc.}$
Pars poſterior ſi n ſit numerus impar.
$-\frac{2n}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+1}}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^{m-1}}-\frac{2n(n+1)(n+2)}{1.\ 2.\ 3}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+3}}\left(\frac{1}{z^{m-3}}\right)-\text{etc.}$
$+\int\frac{1}{z^n}\left(\frac{1}{y^m}\right)+\frac{n}{1}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+1}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{m-1}}\right)+\frac{n(n+1)}{1.\ 2}\int\frac{1}{z^{n+2}}\left(\frac{1}{y^{m-2}}\right)+\text{etc.}$
10.
